titles.native: 神聖かまってちゃん+GAINAX映像チーム

description:
An old cleaner goes on a cleaning rampage in the sewers of a futuristic city, after he lost his job to a robot.

Music Video for the song by Shinsei Kamattechan of the same name and seventh part of GAINAX' "Music is SF" series.
